scripts.build:ts: npm run generate:protocol && npm run compile:ts
scripts.build:native: node scripts/run-cargo.js build --locked -p kbc-node && npm run copy:native
scripts.build:native:release: node scripts/run-cargo.js build --release --locked -p kbc-node && npm run copy:native:release
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:local: npm run build:native:release && npm run build:ts
scripts.local: npm run build:local && npm run start:local
